itemListElement.description: Managed service deployed in your own cloud environment.

@graph.name: One Platform. Four Core Advantages.
@graph.description: The four core platform advantages of CockroachDB: resilience, seamless scale, global compliance, and operational cost efficiency.

itemListElement.name: Enable state-of-the-art resilience
itemListElement.description: Survive regional failures with zero data loss, automated failover, and strong consistency. No runbooks and minimal maintenance windows — online upgrades, schema changes, and backups keep everything running smoothly.

itemListElement.name: Scale seamlessly
itemListElement.description: Eliminate manual sharding and scale effortlessly with consistent performance. Start small, scale to hundreds of nodes and petabytes — no app re-architecture required.

itemListElement.name: Deploy global and compliant applications
itemListElement.description: Implement declarative policies to pin data in specific localities and geographic locations. Launch into global markets by enabling compliance and keeping data close to users to reduce latency.

itemListElement.name: Streamline operations and drive cost efficiencies at scale
itemListElement.description: Achieve high cost efficiency and consolidate databases on a modern PostgreSQL platform. Simplify migrations with MOLT and stream real-time updates to analytics across any environment, from laptops to Kubernetes.

@graph.name: Stay Ahead of the Game. Future-Proof Today.
@graph.description: Three modernization paths CockroachDB powers: database modernization, application modernization, and AI-ready infrastructure.

itemListElement.name: Database Modernization
itemListElement.description: Moving away from traditional data infrastructure requires applications and data that are agile, global, and resilient. CockroachDB is a modern database that enables organizations to navigate database modernization with confidence.

itemListElement.name: Application Modernization
itemListElement.description: Cloud-native applications, microservices, and DevOps demand a fresh approach for managing and storing data. CockroachDB enables you to move to modern application architectures.

itemListElement.name: Artificial Intelligence
itemListElement.description: As other databases struggle to scale globally, degrade under concurrency, and incur downtime with agents and AI data, CockroachDB delivers the highest scale and proven availability for AI-driven applications.
